entry.name: Playwright's WebKit
entry.source: playwright-core 1.63.0 from registry.npmjs.org (npm lockfile sha512 integrity); WebKit r2359 (ubuntu22.04-x64) downloaded by `playwright-core install webkit` from Playwright's CDN; Node v24.21.0 from nodejs.org
entry.verified: Node v24.21.0 linux-x64 tarball: SHA-256 matches SHASUMS256.txt, whose signature is good (gpg, Node release key 5BE8A3F6C8A5C01D106C0AD820B1A390B168D356 from github.com/nodejs/release-keys). playwright-core: npm sha512 integrity. WebKit build: Playwright publishes no checksums or signatures for its browser builds (HTTPS from its CDN only). System libraries: playwright install-deps webkit (sudo apt-get, Ubuntu signed repositories, 128 packages)
entry.notes: Test-only. Playwright's patched WebKit build, headless, launched by server.sh (webkit.launchServer on 127.0.0.1) and driven from the dev machine by tests/browsers/playwright.mjs over Playwright's protocol; the client there must be the same playwright-core version. Downloads go through Playwright (saved on the dev machine, copied back into the run's download folder), not the browser's own download handling.
